runs.summary: Firecrawl discovery fully degraded today, so this run fell back to a fresh live-search pass across direct operators, StreetEasy, and NYBits. Beatrice remained the only strict shortlist survivor. Several new pages surfaced plausible monitor inventory, led by 53 Leroy #1C, 209 East 25th #1A, and Iris Tribeca #11A, but no 2BR/2BA or true 3BR/3BA listing cleared the proof bar strongly enough for shortlist status.
runs.notes: This run began with `npm run discover:apartments -- --date 2026-05-19 --out data/firecrawl-discovery/2026-05-19.json`. The discovery file returned `status: degraded`, `degraded: true`, zero candidates retained, and 27 fetch failures, so discovery was replaced with a broad live-search workflow rather than seeding from stored candidates. Firecrawl query set used the standard 18-query pack spanning 1BR, 2BR/2BA, and true 3BR/3BA discovery plus StreetEasy/Zillow/Apartments.com/RentHop site queries. Mapped roots were Equity Apartments, Avalon Communities, Brodsky, Stonehenge NYC, Rockrose, EVE NYC, StuyTown / Beam Living, The Chelsea / Greystar, and Chelsea29. Verification then proceeded from opened live pages only.
blindSpots: Firecrawl discovery degraded completely today: zero retained candidates, zero direct-operator candidates, and 27 fetch failures across all search and map attempts.

Firecrawl query set used the standard 18 discovery queries; mapped roots were Equity Apartments, Avalon Communities, Brodsky, Stonehenge NYC, Rockrose, EVE NYC, StuyTown / Beam Living, The Chelsea / Greystar, and Chelsea29.
EVE direct unit URLs that were usable yesterday now redirect to generic availability/contact pages, so exact live unit verification was not possible from the opened operator page.
Some StreetEasy building pages exposed current units, but unit-level appliance and HVAC details remained incomplete unless a separate unit page was available.
NYBits surfaced several plausible leads, but some pages still showed old availability dates without a clear off-market flag, which kept timing confidence below shortlist level.
Beam / StuyTown inventory was not accessible with enough direct unit detail in this run to satisfy the stricter shortlist proof standard.

listings.name: Beatrice Apartments 1 Bedroom I.2 floor 28
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened Equity availability page; the same page showed the 643 sq ft 1BR at $5,831 and tied the unit to direct amenities and floor-plan media.

commute.route: R/W to Prince Street or a low-20s walk
commute.notes: Straightforward no-transfer commute with a strong walking fallback.

amenities: Central heat and AC in all rooms
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened Equity page explicitly listed in-home washer and dryer, dishwasher, central heat and AC in all rooms, floor-to-ceiling windows, and 10 foot ceilings for the live Beatrice inventory.
listings.furnitureFit: High confidence yes. The 643 sq ft plan and live floor-plan media make the 100 inch couch plus ottoman and coffee table look comfortably workable.
caveats: Near the top of the preferred 1BR range.
Chelsea / NoMad edge rather than deeper village.
listings.notes: Still the cleanest live 1BR by proof quality, space confidence, commute, and must-have tie-out.
